map.HIIT / 循环训练计时，自定义训练、休息时长与轮数，组间自动切换提醒: HIIT / circuit training timer with custom work, rest and round settings and automatic interval switching reminders
map.单轮时长 = 训练时长 + 休息时长；训练总时长 = (训练时长 + 休息时长): Round duration = work duration + rest duration; total training time = (work duration + rest duration) × rounds; total including preparation = total training time + preparation duration
map.例如训练 40 秒、休息 20 秒、8 轮、准备 10 秒：单轮 60 秒，训练: For example, work 40 s, rest 20 s, 8 rounds, preparation 10 s: round duration 60 s, total training time 60×8 = 480 s (8 minutes), 490 s including preparation. The timer automatically switches between work and rest for each segment and tracks the cumulative training minutes.
map.提示：训练时保持动作标准，休息时主动恢复（慢走、深呼吸）。结束后做 5 分钟拉伸: Note: keep good form during work and recover actively during rest (slow walking, deep breathing). Do a 5-minute stretch at the end to aid recovery.
map.做 Tabata/循环训练（HIIT）时，按「训练+休息」轮次自动: During Tabata / circuit training (HIIT), automatically count down by work + rest rounds
map.，解放双手不用盯表。: , freeing your hands from watching the clock.
map.规划一次训练的总时长：单轮时长×轮数+准备倒计时，便于排入日程。: Plan the total duration of a session: round duration × rounds + ready countdown, making it easy to fit into your schedule.
map.调整 work/rest/rounds 适配不同水平（新手长休息、进阶短休息多轮: Adjust work/rest/rounds to suit different levels (longer rests for beginners, shorter rests and more rounds for advanced users).
map.可复现算例：40/20 × 8 轮的总时长: Reproducible example: total duration of 40/20 × 8 rounds
map.输入：训练 workSec=40、休息 restSec=20、轮数 rounds:
Input: work workSec=40, rest restSec=20, rounds rounds=8, preparation readySec=10.
Round duration=workSec+restSec=40+20=60 s.
Total training time=(workSec+restSec)×rounds=60×8=480 s=8 minutes.
Including the ready countdown=480+10=490 s≈8 min 10 s.
Conclusion: this 8-round circuit is 8 minutes of net training, plus 10 seconds of preparation before starting, finishing in about 8 min 10 s overall.
map.轮数/时长怎么设？: How should I set rounds and duration?
map.新手建议 20–30s 训练+20–30s 休息、6–8 轮；进阶可 40s 训: For beginners, 20-30 s work + 20-30 s rest for 6-8 rounds; for advanced, 40 s work + 15-20 s rest for 8-12 rounds. Total training time ≈ (work+rest)×rounds, so you can work backwards from your schedule.
map.计时器支持跳过当前阶段直接进入下一 phase（准备→训练→休息→完成），便于临: The timer supports skipping the current stage and moving straight to the next phase (ready → work → rest → done) for on-the-fly adjustments; the cumulative stats record the training sessions and minutes actually completed.
